verdict.summary: Round 2 confirms the prior approval. The pretest derives runtime dependencies from the manifest, adds the TypeScript loader dependency, resolves from the package source context, and produces actionable failure output. The package script and documented gui.yml lane agree with the workflow. The bzip2 regression is non-vacuous: its independently reconstructed 250,000-byte alphabet expectation checks complete ordered content, while the extension test now rejects a missing decoder module instead of accepting any failure. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue was found.
